correctness.rationale: Each source concurrence branch is monotone in nu=sqrt(P^2+D^2), so its zero boundary is uniquely obtained by inverse hyperbolic functions. Explicit inequalities place those boundaries on opposite sides of nu_c=A+Z. Exact exponential forms of the boundary equations yield nu_c-u_- ~ T exp(-2A/T) and u_+-nu_c ~ T exp(-2A/T); smooth conversion from nu to D gives the claimed width.
